item.title: [ 6 Maps ] Glubtastic 5
item.description:
View Article
Media
Media gallery
1 / 5
Glubtastic 5 has been out for two years now, but it was only exclusive to Steam. Well, here it is for Gamemaps, this version only includes minor patches and bug fixes (just the .nav and .lmp files) some unnecessary materials and models were removed for better optimization. As already hinted, this is the final chapter of the Glubtastic saga. --READ BEFORE YOU COMMENT-- This campaign uses ALOT of custom scripted content, so scripted mods may mess with it. (Random crashes are almost always caused by mods you are running). Using dedicated servers will likely cause issues, we strongly recommend running on a local host.

item.title: [ Mod ] Advanced Bot AI Enhanced V4
item.description:
View Article
Media
Media gallery
1 / 1
Advanced Bot AI incompatible with Left 4 Bots, Left 4 Lib, Merciless Survivor Bots (any version), among other modifications that alter the behavior of bots or infected -Bot gives away (medical kit, pills, adrenaline, molotov, pipebomb, vomitjar) -Bot uses throwable objects (molotov, pipebomb, vomitjar) -Bot carries gasoline canister, gas bottle, oxygen tank, soft drinks and a gnome on his back -Bot uses melee weapons -Bot uses tertiary weapons (chainsaw, custom weapons, m60, 50cal, minigun) -Bot uses defibrillator -Bot continues to the shelter if you die -Bot can rescue you if you die -Bot helps itself if it falls off a ledge or is incapacitated -Special infected with balanced health (smoker, hunter, jockey, spitter: 1000hp)(boomer: 1500hp)(charger, witch: 2500hp)(tank: 8000hp) Note: This mod includes custom HUD, optimization, and Realistic FX Pack

item.title: [ 5 Maps ] Heaven Can Wait 2
item.description:
View Article
Media
Media gallery
1 / 8
After surviving an air crash, the survivors turn out to be in most epicenter of the contamination. The Military has already left all attempts to rescue survivors in the region. Thanks to Gajofra for creating loading screen art and Marcos Outsider from "Project Detonado" Youtube channel for gamemaps thumbnail. Just to clarify: I did this conversion with Rombikon (Romka) and AGRESSOR authorization, Rombikon sent the L4D1 source to me by email, and I worked on it. First version was based on original campaign, after I modded it with versus changes but keeping native AI director difficulty. I mean the true Rombikon, not that account registered in this site claiming to be HCW author. The real Rombikon said to me his account was given to a guy of project, probably Rustem666666 (Rustemka), then both account are the same people. I'm not responsible by HCW Hard version. I sent source code to Rustemka in the past but rather he created a new hard version, instead to improve the old one.
